current_activity: LXXXVI Corps holding the eastern end of the Normandy front, from the Channel coast along the Orne to Caen (1 July)
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 2 p. 30: "On 1 July the corps that faced the Allies lined up from east to west in the following order: LXXXVI, I SS Panzer, II SS Panzer, XLVII Panzer, II Parachute, and LXXXIV"; ch. 2 p. 29 has the LXXXVI Corps moved in mid-June to take the front between Caen and the Seine; the Lexikon der Wehrmacht LXXXVI Corps page has it inserted into the front line on 20 June with the sector from the Channel coast along the Orne to Caen. Location: the sector centre; the point is the dataset place Orne bridgehead / east of Caen, with a precision of 10 km, because the corps held the ground east of the Orne up to Caen. Location approximate: no source read gives the corps command post place, so the point stands for the sector and not for the headquarters. Relationship: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 2 p. 30: on 28 June Panzer Group West took control of the four corps on the right, which are the first four of the order of 1 July. Commander: General der Infanterie Hans von Obstfelder, who moved the corps from the Bay of Biscay (ch. 2 p. 29).
